scope: Previously exposed Ordinary TRAIN panel; 1536 expressions, 3072 direction records, 512 per direction
subject_candidates: Exactly the 256 v1 original proposals with their existing PCA yaw and fixed point seed 0

training.objective: Negative log probability mass on source proposals with exact oriented IoU > 0.25; rows without a positive proposal are counted and skipped for loss
training.architecture: Bounded additive residual over frozen overlap prior, 196->32->1, zero final layer initialization; source-specific heads on frozen query and subject/full-text matching features

shortlist.incumbent: v1 final winner is inserted before diversity selection for every K and retains its original decoder slot
shortlist.diversity: Existing v1 overlap threshold of 0.35 with ranking fallback to fill exactly K, applied identically to trained and frozen scores
shortlist.ordering: Retained v1 hypotheses stay in their original slots. Other slots filled with selected proposals in frozen overlap-prior order.
shortlist.readout: Existing frozen v1 wider readout from the local ablation with extra subject slots sharing the fourth embedding; same four reference anchors, priors and token masks as v1; original v1 priors for all subjects

select_k: One K per source, the same for both outgoing directions. Maximize source recording-held-out actual Acc25, then Acc50, then mIoU, then smaller K. Only the trained retriever plans K. The frozen control copies its K.
measurements: Recall@K is the fraction of all records with an available shortlist box above strict IoU 0.25 or 0.50; additionally report conditional recall given a pool hit.
Four-slot miss means no v1 slot is above threshold while A256 contains a passing box. Report new recall, final rescues, outsider rescues outside the miss subset, and harms versus v1.
Report whether retrieved good boxes are within the frozen decoder's prior margin bound (2.5 with reference; 1.5 without), for diagnosis after sealing.
Equal six directions, paired recording resampling and complete signed scalar outcomes.
decision: A retrieval candidate advances to locked ordinary validation only if source-selected K improves overall actual Acc25 over v1 and same-K frozen retrieval, with no net overall Acc50 harm. Report per-direction and recall effects regardless.
